labels.rationale: All state is clocked directly by clk. en is a synchronous data enable, not a gate on the clock, and en/d/reset have clk-relative timing contracts.
en selects a data update under the declared clk, with clk-relative timing for en and d. No gated clock or clock-domain crossing is created.
